repos.name: hezo-ai/hezo
repos.description: Your own AI workforce. Built to ship.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI workforce platform designed for production-grade software delivery.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-performance agentic workflows.
Focuses on end-to-end automation of software development lifecycles.
Enables teams to deploy autonomous agents to handle complex coding and shipping tasks.
Designed for scalability in professional engineering environments.

repos.name: diffusionstudio/editor
repos.description: The open-source video editor built for your coding agents
repos.one_liner: An open-source video editing platform specifically engineered for integration with coding agents.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture optimized for programmatic video manipulation.
Provides an API-first interface for AI agents to perform automated video editing.
Facilitates the creation of dynamic media content via agentic workflows.
Useful for automated content generation pipelines and AI-driven media production.

repos.name: XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt
repos.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
repos.one_liner: A framework that pairs ChatGPT's planning capabilities with Codex's execution harness.
bullets: Combines LLM reasoning for high-level planning with specialized code generation models.
Implements a modular architecture to separate intent from implementation.
Enhances reliability in automated coding tasks by decoupling strategy from syntax.
Ideal for building complex agentic systems that require precise code execution.

repos.name: jprx/darwin-vm
repos.description: Run iOS/ macOS in Qemu. Virtual iPhone 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12 and M5-M1 Apple Si Macs supported.
repos.one_liner: A virtualization tool for running macOS and iOS environments within QEMU.
bullets: Leverages QEMU infrastructure to emulate Apple Silicon and mobile hardware.
Supports a wide range of virtualized iPhone and Mac environments.
Provides critical infrastructure for cross-platform testing and security research.
Enables automated CI/CD pipelines for mobile and desktop applications on non-Apple hardware.

repos.name: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
repos.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
repos.one_liner: An immersive multi-agent interactive classroom environment for collaborative learning.
bullets: TypeScript-based framework for orchestrating multiple autonomous agents.
Simulates complex interactive scenarios for training and educational research.
Provides a sandbox for testing multi-agent coordination and communication protocols.
Applicable for modeling agentic behavior in collaborative or competitive environments.
